intents.title: Services Overview
intents.summary: Anot Health supports healthcare teams across clinical documentation, revenue cycle support, coding and compliance, payroll administration, and implementation planning.
highlights: Clinical Documentation is built to reduce after-hours charting and improve note readiness.
Revenue Cycle support is positioned around cleaner claims, fewer preventable rework loops, and steadier collections.
Coding and Compliance support focuses on specificity, reimbursement logic, and audit confidence.
Payroll Administration support helps reconcile provider compensation inputs and finance handoffs.
intents.bestFit: This is the best starting answer when a buyer is trying to understand whether Anot is a documentation-only vendor or a broader healthcare operations partner.
intents.nextStep: If you want a narrower answer, ask which service line is the best fit for your current bottleneck.

intents.title: Pricing Overview
intents.summary: Anot has three plans: **AI Scribe** at {{price.ai}} per provider per month, **Verified Scribe** at {{price.verified}} per provider per month, and **Custom** pricing for groups that add billing, coding and payroll. {{price.billing}}
highlights: AI Scribe ({{price.ai}}/month): ambient AI drafts the SOAP note in your EHR, with suggested ICD-10 and CPT codes. You review and sign.
Verified Scribe ({{price.verified}}/month): a certified scribe and a QPS clinical auditor check every note, so it arrives sign-ready. Up to 400 reviewed notes per month.
Custom: for multi-site clinics and health systems bundling documentation with billing, coding and payroll.
No contracts and no surprise fees. Paying yearly saves 15%.
intents.bestFit: This answer is most useful when someone wants the headline prices before comparing plans.
intents.nextStep: See the full comparison on the [pricing page](pricing.html), or [book a pricing walkthrough](contact.html).

intents.title: AI Scribe Plan
intents.summary: AI Scribe is {{price.ai}} per provider per month. Ambient AI captures the visit and drafts a structured SOAP note directly in your EHR; you review and sign it.
highlights: Structured SOAP notes with HPI, ROS, exam and assessment & plan.
Keeps your EHR template and specialty voice.
Suggested ICD-10 and CPT codes.
Unlimited encounters per provider, with no shift limits.
intents.bestFit: Best when the provider is comfortable checking the AI draft themselves before signing.
intents.nextStep: If you want a human to check every note before you see it, ask about Verified Scribe.

intents.title: Verified Scribe Plan
intents.summary: Verified Scribe is {{price.verified}} per provider per month. Everything in AI Scribe, plus a certified medical scribe and a QPS clinical auditor review every note, so it arrives sign-ready.
highlights: Every note is inspected by a dedicated certified scribe.
QPS clinical audit checks dosages, laterality and diagnoses.
ICD-10 and CPT codes are reviewed by a certified coder.
Includes up to 400 reviewed notes per month, a named onboarding specialist and priority support.
intents.bestFit: Best when accuracy has to be checked by people before the note reaches the provider.
intents.nextStep: [Book a walkthrough](contact.html) to see a reviewed note for your specialty.

intents.title: Custom Plan
intents.summary: Custom is scoped per organization for multi-site clinics, health systems and groups that bundle documentation with billing, coding and payroll.
highlights: Everything in Verified Scribe.
Revenue cycle billing, coding and payroll included in scope.
Volume discounts across sites and custom EHR integration.
A dedicated account director with a contractual uptime SLA.
intents.bestFit: Best for groups that want one partner for documentation and revenue operations.

intents.title: Clinical Documentation Model
intents.summary: Anot's documentation model is built around AI-assisted speed with human review before the output becomes operationally relied on.
highlights: AI helps with drafting, structure, and first-pass speed.
Experienced healthcare professionals review and refine the work before handoff.
The operating goal is dependable note readiness rather than unreviewed automation.
intents.bestFit: This is the strongest answer when a buyer is evaluating whether Anot is replacing humans with AI or combining AI with expert oversight.
intents.nextStep: Ask about turnaround, provider relief, specialty fit, or how the review layer changes by pricing tier.

intents.title: Revenue Cycle Support
intents.summary: Anot positions revenue cycle support around better documentation inputs, cleaner claim preparation, and fewer preventable rework loops downstream.
highlights: The site emphasizes stronger claim readiness and cleaner handoffs into billing workflows.
The value story is tied to reducing preventable rework and stabilizing collections.
The strongest results usually depend on documentation and coding quality improving upstream.
intents.bestFit: This answer is most useful when a practice wants to know whether Anot helps only with notes or also with financial workflow quality.
intents.nextStep: Ask whether your main pressure is claim quality, denials, coding follow-up, or collections timing.

intents.title: Coding And Compliance Support
intents.summary: Anot positions coding and compliance support around specificity, reimbursement logic, and stronger review confidence before downstream decisions depend on the work.
highlights: The coding story is tied to documentation quality, audit confidence, and reimbursement alignment.
The site frames this as a protection against weak specificity and preventable coding risk.
It is especially relevant when the practice wants stronger review discipline before submission.
intents.bestFit: This answer fits when the buyer is worried about coding quality, audit exposure, or reimbursement logic rather than only note speed.
intents.nextStep: Ask whether you want clarity around compliance confidence, specificity, or coding workflow fit.

intents.title: Payroll Administration Support
intents.summary: Anot positions payroll administration around cleaner provider compensation inputs, reconciliation support, and fewer manual finance handoffs.
highlights: The workflow is framed for practices that still reconcile provider hours, schedules, and compensation logic manually.
The value is strongest when finance and operational data do not line up cleanly today.
It is described as support for steadier and more disciplined payroll workflows.
intents.bestFit: This answer is useful when a buyer wants to know whether Anot extends beyond clinical workflows into administrative operations.
intents.nextStep: Ask whether your main issue is reconciliation, compensation inputs, or provider-pay workflow coordination.

intents.title: HIPAA And Trust
intents.summary: Anot presents its trust posture around privacy-conscious workflows, operational safeguards, and expert review discipline rather than unreviewed automation.
highlights: HIPAA, privacy, and controlled handling of healthcare workflows are recurring themes on the site.
The model emphasizes oversight and workflow discipline, not only policy language.
Trust is framed as part of how the work is done, not only as a legal statement.
intents.bestFit: This is the right answer when a buyer wants to know whether Anot takes trust and workflow controls seriously before relying on the output.
intents.nextStep: Ask whether you want the trust answer framed around HIPAA, privacy, or implementation safeguards.

intents.title: Canadian Privacy (PIPEDA)
intents.summary: For Canadian clinics, Anot states compliance with PIPEDA and provincial health privacy laws, including PHIPA (Ontario), HIA (Alberta), PIPA (British Columbia) and Quebec Law 25.
highlights: Clinical notes, audio processing and database records are hosted in AWS Canada Central, so PHI stays in Canada.
Data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.
Anot signs Information Manager Agreements (IMAs) and Canadian Data Processing Agreements with each clinic.
Controls are covered by a SOC 2 Type II report, available to Canadian clinics on request.
intents.bestFit: This answer is most useful for Canadian clinics checking privacy and data residency.
intents.nextStep: Read the [PIPEDA Trust Center](pipeda.html) or email admin@anot.health for the compliance documents.

intents.title: Implementation Approach
intents.summary: Anot's implementation story is built around stabilizing the highest-pressure workflow first and expanding deliberately from there.
highlights: The site emphasizes phased rollout logic rather than a one-size-fits-all deployment story.
The model is meant to fit around the operational bottleneck that needs relief first.
The best implementation conversation usually starts with the workflow that is absorbing the most manual cleanup today.
intents.bestFit: This is the strongest answer when someone asks how the rollout works or how Anot would fit into an existing practice workflow.
intents.nextStep: Ask about onboarding, turnaround, or which team usually feels the earliest operational impact.

intents.title: Specialty Fit
intents.summary: Anot's specialty fit depends less on a simple yes-or-no answer and more on note structure, vocabulary, documentation density, and workflow variability.
highlights: The site indicates support for varied clinical workflows rather than one narrow specialty profile.
The best specialty conversation usually starts with documentation complexity and provider variation.
Pricing fit can change when specialty nuance materially changes the review burden.
intents.bestFit: This answer is useful when the user asks whether Anot can support a specific specialty such as cardiology or a multispecialty group.
intents.nextStep: Ask about your specialty directly and I can frame the answer around fit, complexity, and likely pricing tier.

intents.title: Dashboard Access
intents.summary: Existing customers sign in to the Anot Health dashboard at [app.anot.health](https://app.anot.health).
highlights: The dashboard is a separate application from this website.
If you need an account, your organization administrator can add you, or email admin@anot.health.
intents.bestFit: This answer is most useful when someone asks where to log in or how the dashboard relates to the website.
intents.nextStep: For product access go to [app.anot.health](https://app.anot.health); for a sales conversation, [book a demo](contact.html).

intents.title: Contact And Demo
intents.summary: Anot encourages direct outreach through the demo flow or the team email when a buyer wants a workflow-specific conversation.
highlights: The public contact email is admin@anot.health.
The Get a Demo flow is positioned for workflow-specific discussions rather than a generic product tour.
The strongest demo requests usually explain which service line or operational bottleneck needs relief first.
intents.bestFit: This answer is useful when the user is ready to talk to the team or wants to know the best next step after learning the basics.
intents.nextStep: Use the demo flow and frame the request around the workflow that needs relief first.
